_comment: The simulated ePixUHR 3x2 for psdaq.sim.rogue_dev: one readout system (ROS[0]) of epixuhr_3x2_readout_testing's Root, which psdaq/configdb/epixuhr3x2_config.py builds: the data C1100 card (DataFpga[0], on the PCIe map) and the front-end board (FebFpga, behind SRPv3). Keys are pyrogue register paths; values are what the hardware reports.
_PCIE_HW_TYPE_G: the data card is a Varium C1100 (AxiPcieCore checks the hardware type its firmware was built for)
_CmsBridge: the C1100 card's management (axipcie CmsProxy): at start it resets the mailbox and waits for HOST_STATUS2_REG bit 0 (ready) and REG_MAP_ID_REG 'test'; the mailbox's requests are answered by rogue_dev's CmsFirmware
_RxId: the XPM's remote link id; the DRP takes the link id simxpm assigns, not this one
